description: Uzbek keyboard that converts text to the new 2026 Latin alphabet (ö ğ ş ç) as you type.
notes: bitg is a Windows input method (TSF). Press Win + Space and choose bitg.
It is installed per machine through its MSI, so Windows asks for administrator rights (UAC) once.

script: # '.msi_': Scoop MSI'ni ochib yubormasin, IME tizimda ro'yxatdan o'tishi uchun msiexec bilan o'rnatiladi
$p = if ($admin) { Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $argv -Wait -PassThru } else { Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $argv -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru }
if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010, 1641) { throw "bitg MSI: msiexec exit code $($p.ExitCode), log: $log" }
# scoop update: yangi MSI eski versiyani MajorUpgrade bilan o'zi almashtiradi, oldindan o'chirilmaydi
# ProductCode har build'da yangi: o'rnatilgan bitg UpgradeCode bo'yicha topiladi
$p = if ($admin) { Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $argv -Wait -PassThru } else { Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $argv -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru }
if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010, 1605, 1614, 1641) { throw "bitg MSI: msiexec /x exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
